English: A remote working environment refers to working outside the traditional workspace.

English: Such environments define working as a mobile activity rather than needing a specific space to accomplish it.
Luganda: Embeera ey’engeri eyo eyoleka okukola ng’ekintu ekikolerwa buli wamu mu kifo ky’okuba nti ekintu ekyo kikolerwa mu kifo ekitongole.
Yoruba: Irúfẹ́ àwọn agbègbè báyìí túmọ iṣẹ́ ṣíṣe sí ohun àṣelọ́nà láì fi ti nínílò ibìkan pàtó láti ṣiṣẹ́.

Hausa: Irin waɗannan mahallan suna bayyana aiki a zaman aiki daga nesa maimakon buƙatar takamaiman wuri domin gudanar da shi.
Northern Sotho: Maemo a mohuta woo a hlaloša go šoma bjalo ka tiro ya go šutha sebakeng sa go hloka lefelo le itšego go go fihlelela.
Amharic: እንደነዚህ ያሉ አካባቢዎች ሥራን ለማከናወን የተለየ ቦታ ከመፈለግ ይልቅ እንደ ተንቀሳቃሽ እንቅስቃሴ ይገልጻሉ።

English: Remote work has been around for some time before the pandemic however, the quarantine and lockdown protocols pushed many organizations to adopt the system.
Luganda: Okukolera ewaka kubaddengawo okumala akaseera nga nawookeera w'obulwadde tannajja, wabula kalantiini n'ebigobererwa mu muggalo byawaliriza ebitongole bingi okweyuna enkola eyo.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi ti wà láti káàkiri fún ìgbà díẹ̀ báyìí kí àjàkálẹ̀ àrún tó bẹ́ẹ̀rẹ̀ àmọ́, ìsémọ́lé àti ìlànà ìtìpa ti ọ̀pọ ilé-iṣẹ́ láti ṣe ìṣàmúlò ètò náà.
Zulu: Umsebenzi osekude usunesikhathi eside ukhona ngaphambi kwalolu bhubhane, nokho, izimiso zokuhlukaniswa kwabantu kanye ne-Lockdown zacindezela izinhlangano eziningi ukuthi zamukele lolu hlelo.
Hausa: Aikin daga nesa ya kasance na ɗan lokaci kafin ɓarkewar annobar, duk da haka, ƙa’idojin keɓewa da ƙa’idojin kulle sun tilastawa ƙungiyoyi da yawa wajen ɗaukar tsarin.
Northern Sotho: Go šma o le kgole go bile gona mo nakong ye telele le peleng ga leuba, le ge go le bjale, ditshepedišo tša go beela balwetši thoko le go ba hlaola go dirile gore dikhamphani tše ntši go amogela tshepedišo ye.
Amharic: ወረርሽኙ ከመከሰቱ በፊት የርቀት ሥራ ነበረ፣ ነገር ግን የኳራንቲን እና የመቆለፊያ ፕሮቶኮሎች ብዙ ድርጅቶች ስርዓቱን እንዲቀበሉ ገፋፍቷቸዋል።

English: Other organizations have found the conveniences of remote working, including reduced rental expenses and other organizational amenities while maintaining profitability and productivity.
Luganda: Ebitongole ebirala bizudde obulungi bw’okukolera ewaka, omwo nga mwe muli n’okukendeeza ku ssente z’obupangisa ne ku bintu ebirala ebisasulirwa ekitongole olwo amagoba ne geeyongera n’obukozi.
Yoruba: Àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ mìíràn ti rí àìrínira tó wà níbi Iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi, tí kò yẹ̀ léyìn owó ráńpẹ́ fún sísanwó yàrá ilé iṣẹ́ àti àwọn ohun amúṣẹ́yá nílé iṣẹ́ nígbà tí wọ́n ń gbìyànjú láti jèrè kí wọ́n sì ṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa.
Zulu: Ezinye izinhlangano zithole ukunethezeka kokusebenza kude, okuhlanganisa izindleko ezincishisiwe zokuqasha nezinye izinsiza zenhlangano kuyilapho kugcinwa inzuzo kanye nokukhiqiza.
Hausa: Wasu ƙungiyoyi sun sami jin daɗin aiki daga nesa, gami da rage kuɗin haya da sauran abubuwan more rayuwa na ƙungiyar yayin da suke ci gaba da samun riba da kuma wadata.
Northern Sotho: Dikhamphani tše dingwe di hweditše menyetla ya go šoma o le kgole, go akaretšwa phokotšo ya ditshenyegelo tša rente le ditshenyegelo tše dingwe tša khamphani mola ka go le lengwe di eba le poelo le tšweletšo.
Amharic: ሌሎች ድርጅቶች ትርፋማነትን እና ምርታማነትን እየጠበቁ የኪራይ ወጪዎችን እና ሌሎች ድርጅታዊ አገልግሎቶችን ጨምሮ የርቀት ስራን ምቾት አግኝተዋል።

English: The remote working environment is here to stay in the professional realm; hence this seminar paper seeks to look at organizations in Kenya.
Luganda: Okukolera ewaka kulabika nga si kwakuvaawo mu bukozi obw’ekikugu; kale nno emboozi eno eruubirira kutunuulira bitongole mu Kenya.
Yoruba: Àwọn agbègbe Iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi náà ti wà láti jẹ́ ohun àwùjọ níbi iṣẹ́ lóríṣirísi; nítorí bẹ́ẹ̀ ìwé sẹ́mínà yìí fẹ́ ṣe àyẹ̀wo àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ ní Kenya.
Zulu: Indawo yokusebenza ekude ilapha ukuze uhlale endaweni yobungcweti; yingakho leli phepha lesemina lifuna ukubheka izinhlangano eKenya.
Hausa: Yanayin aiki daga nesa ya zo domin zama dindindin a cikin ɓangaren ƙwararru; domin haka, wannan takarda ta ƙarawa juna sani tana neman duba ƙungiyoyi a ƙasar Kenya.
Northern Sotho: Seemo sa go šoma o le kgole se tlo dula se le gona ka lekaleng la tša sephrofešenale; ke ka lebaka leo sengwalwa se sa seminara se nyaka go lekola dikhamphani tša ka Kenya.
Amharic: የርቀት የሥራ አካባቢ በሙያዊ መስክ ውስጥ ይቆያል; ስለዚህ ይህ የሴሚናር ወረቀት በኬንያ ያሉ ድርጅቶችን ለመመልከት ይፈልጋል።

English: Most sectors in Kenya were adversely affected by the remote working environment.
Luganda: Ebitongole ebisinga mu Kenya byakosebwa nnyo embeera y’okukolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ẹ̀ka ní kenya rí ipa tí kò dára látara iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi.
Zulu: Imikhakha eminingi eKenya ithinteke kabi ngenxa yendawo yokusebenza ekude.
Hausa: Yawancin sassa a Kenya sun sami matsala sakamakon yanayin aiki daga nesa.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja makala ka Kenya a ile a angwa gampe ke seemo sa go šoma o le kgole.
Amharic: በኬንያ ያሉ አብዛኞቹ ዘርፎች በሩቅ የስራ አካባቢ ክፉኛ ተጎድተዋል።

English: The study adopted the review and analysis methodology of the existing literature, through the Google Scholar search engine and Z- library by use of keywords to investigate the impact of remote working environments on employee productivity, attitudes, and challenges to Kenyan organizations.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakozesa akakodyo k’okwekaliriza ebiwandiiko ebiriwo, okuva mu nnoonyeeso ya Google Scholar ne Z- library nga tukozesa ebigambo ebikulu okunoonyereza ku mbeera y’okukolera ewaka nga bw’ekola ku bukozi bw’abakozi, endowooza yaabwe, n’okusoomooza mu bitonogle by’e Kenya.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ṣe ìṣàmúlò ìgbéyẹ̀wò àti ìtúpalẹ̀ ọgbọ́n ìṣèwádìí àwọn lítírésọ̀ tó wà tẹ́lẹ̀, látara ẹ̀rọ Google Scholar ati z-library nípa ṣíṣàmúlò kókó-ọ̀rọ̀ láti wádíi ipa tí iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi kó lórí àbájáde iṣẹ́ àwọn òsìṣẹ́, ìṣe wọn, àti ìdojúkọ sí àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ Kenya.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwamukele indlela yokubuyekeza nokuhlaziya yezincwadi ezikhona, kusetshenziswa injini yokusesha ye-Google Scholar kanye nomtapo wolwazi we-Z ngokusebenzisa amagama angukhiye ukuze kuphenywe umthelela wezindawo zokusebenza ezikude ekukhiqizeni kwabasebenzi, izimo zengqondo, nezinselele ezinhlanganweni zaseKenya.
Hausa: Binciken ya yi amfani da tsarin bita da nazari na wallafe-wallafen da ake da su, ta hanyar injin bincike na Google Scholar da Z- library ta hanyar amfani da kalmomi domin bincika tasirin yanayin aiki na nesa a kan yawan ma'aikata da halaye da kuma ƙalubaloli ga ƙungiyoyin Kenya.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di šomišitše mokgwa wa tekodišišo le wa tshekatsheko wa dingwalwa tše di lego gona, ka go diriša Google Scholar le Z- library ka go šomiša mantšu a bohlokwa go nyakišiša seabe sa seemo sa go šoma o le kgole mabapi le tšweletšo ya bašomi, mekgwa, le ditlhohlo go mekgatlo ya ka Kenya.
Amharic: ጥናቱ የርቀት የስራ አካባቢዎች በሰራተኞች ምርታማነት፣አመለካከት እና በኬንያ ድርጅቶች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ተግዳሮቶች ለመፈተሽ በGoogle ስኮላር የፍለጋ ሞተር እና ዜድ-ላይብረሪ ቁልፍ ቃላት በመጠቀም የነባር ስነ-ፅሁፎችን የግምገማ እና የመተንተን ዘዴን ተቀብሏል።

English: The paper also looks at the overall organizational performance in a remote working environment.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, olupapula era lutunuulira ekifaananyi ekyawamu eky’enkola y’ebitongole mu mbeera y’okukolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí tún wo ìkójọpọ̀ àbájáde ìṣe àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ ní agbègbe iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi.
Zulu: Iphepha liphinde libheke ukusebenza kwenhlangano kukonke endaweni yokusebenza ekude.
Hausa: Takardar ta kuma duba gabaɗayan aikin ƙungiyar a cikin wurin aiki na nesa.
Northern Sotho: Sengwalwa se lekodišišitše gape go šoma ka kakaretšo ga dikhamphani ka seemong sa go šoma o le kgole.
Amharic: ወረቀቱ በሩቅ የስራ አካባቢ ያለውን አጠቃላይ ድርጅታዊ አፈጻጸምም ይመለከታል።

English: The study reveals that employee performance and attitude are significantly boosted in the remote working environment.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kulaga nti obukozi bw’abakozi n’endowooza yaabwe bitumbulwa nnyo mu mbeera y’okukolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà fi hàn pé àbájáde iṣẹ́ àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ àti ìṣe wọn dára púpọ̀ ní agbègbe iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi ukusebenza kwabasebenzi nesimo sengqondo kukhula kakhulu endaweni yokusebenza ekude.
Hausa: Binciken ya nuna cewa ayyukan ma’aikata da halaye suna haɓaka sosai a cikin yanayin aiki na nesa.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di utolla gore go šoma ga bašomi le mekgwa ya bona di thekgwa kudu ka seemong sa go šoma o le kgole.
Amharic: ጥናቱ እንደሚያሳየው የሰራተኛው አፈፃፀም እና አመለካከት በሩቅ የስራ አካባቢ ውስጥ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየጨመረ ነው።

English: Distractions and lack of proper utilities were highlighted as the key challenges faced by employees in remote working environments.
Luganda: Okusoomooza okukulu okwalengerwa mu kunoonyereza kuno mwalimu abakozi obutaba na bikozesebwa birungi mu mbeera y’okukolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Ìdíwọ́ àti owó ohun amúṣẹ́rọrùn ni ìtọ́ka wà pé ó jẹ́ okùfa ìdojúkọ tí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ń kojú ní àwọn agbègbe iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi.
Zulu: Iziphazamiso nokuntuleka kwezinsiza ezifanele kwagqanyiswa njengezinselelo ezibalulekile abasebenzi ababhekana nazo ezindaweni ezikude zokusebenza.
Hausa: An bayyana abubuwan jan hankali da rashin ingantattun abubuwan amfani a matsayin manyan ƙalubalolin da ma’aikata suke fuskanta a wuraren aiki na nesa.
Northern Sotho: Ditšhitišo le tlhokego ya ditlabelo tša maleba di laeditšwe bjalo ka ditlhohlo tše bohlokwa tšeo bašomi ba ilego ba lebana le tšona ka seemong sa go šoma o le kgole.
Amharic: ትኩረትን የሚከፋፍሉ ነገሮች እና የፍጆታ እቃዎች እጥረት በሩቅ የስራ አካባቢዎች ውስጥ ሰራተኞች የሚያጋጥሟቸው ቁልፍ ተግዳሮቶች ተደርገው ተገልጸዋል።

English: The study also recommends the formulation of policies and procedures that will guide employees while choosing a framework for evaluating performance in the remote working environment.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno era kusemba okuteekawo enkola n’emitendera eginaaluŋŋamyanga abakozi nga balondako enkola y’okwekenneenya enkola yaabwe mu mbeera y’okukolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà tún dábáa ìgbékalẹ̀ àwọn òfin àti ìlànà tí ó lè darí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń yan ojú-ìwòye-iṣẹ́ fún ìgbéléwọ̀n àbájáde iṣẹ́ ní àwọn agbègbe iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luphinde luncome ukwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo nezinqubo ezizoqondisa abasebenzi ngenkathi kukhethwa uhlaka lokuhlola ukusebenza endaweni ekude yokusebenza.
Hausa: Har wa yau, binciken ya bayar da shawarar samar da tsare-tsare da hanyoyin da za su jagoranci ma’aikata yayin zaɓar tsarin tantance aiki a cikin wurin aiki na nesa.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di šišinya gape gore go hlangwe melawana le ditshepedišo tšeo di tlago hlahla bašomi ge go kgethwa motheo wa go lekola phethagatšo ya mošomo ka seemong sa go šoma o le kgole.
Amharic: ጥናቱ በሩቅ የስራ አካባቢ የስራ አፈጻጸምን ለመገምገም ማዕቀፍ ሲመርጡ ሰራተኞችን የሚመሩ ፖሊሲዎች እና ሂደቶች እንዲቀረጹ ይመክራል።

English: Kenyan researchers studying the challenges of remote work say that employees can be productive and successful under the right circumstances.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza b’omu Kenya abeekaliriza okusoomooza kw’okukolera ewaka bagamba nti abakozi basobola okukola obulungi n’obuwanguzi nga bali mu mbeera ennungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádíi Kenya tí wọ́n ń ṣèwádìí ildojúko iṣẹ́-ṣíṣe-níbikíbi sọ pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ lè ní àbájáde iṣẹ́ àti ìṣiṣẹ́ dáadáa lábẹ́ àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ tó tọ́.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baseKenya abafunda izinselele zomsebenzi okude bathi abasebenzi bangakhiqiza futhi baphumelele ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele.
Hausa: Masu bincike na Kenya da suke nazarin ƙalubalolin aiki daga nesa sun ce ma’aikata suna iya yin ƙwazo da nasara a ƙarƙashin yanayin da ya dace.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba Kenya bao ba nyakišišago ka ga ditlhohlo tša go šoma o le kgole ba bolela gore bašomi ba ka ba le tšweletšo le go atlega ka fase ga maemo ao a lokilego.
Amharic: የኬንያ ተመራማሪዎች የርቀት ስራን ተግዳሮቶች በማጥናት ሰራተኞች በተገቢው ሁኔታ ምርታማ እና ውጤታማ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ይናገራሉ።

English: What’s important is that companies understand the challenges involved and support their employees to succeed.
Luganda: Ekikulu wano kye kino nti amakampuni gategeera okusoomooza okuli mu kuwagira abakozi okuwangula.
Yoruba: Ohun tó ṣe pàtàkì ni pé kí àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ ní òye nípa ìdojúkọ tọ́ wà kí wọ́n sì gbárùkù ti àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ wọn láti ṣe àṣeyọrí.
Zulu: Okubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqonde izinselele ezihilelekile futhi zisekele abasebenzi bazo ukuze baphumelele.
Hausa: Abin da yake da mahimmanci shi ne cewa kamfanoni sun fahimci ƙalubalolin da suke tattare da su kuma sun tallafa wa ma'aikatansu don samun nasara.
Northern Sotho: Se bohlokwa ke gore dikhamphani di kwešiša ditlhohlo tše di amegago le go thekga bašomi ba tšona go atlega.
Amharic: ዋናው ነገር ኩባንያዎች የሚያጋጥሟቸውን ተግዳሮቶች ተረድተው ሰራተኞቻቸውን እንዲሳካላቸው መደገፋቸው ነው።

English: During the Covid-19 pandemic, companies around the world allowed employees to work remotely (from home) to ensure social distancing, which was an important strategy for controlling the pandemic in the early stages.
Luganda: Mu kiseera kya nnawookeera wa Covid-19, amakampuni okwetooloola wonna mu nsi gakkiriza abakozi okukolera ebbali (ewaka) okusobozesa okwewa amabanga, kano ke kaali akakodyo ak’okuziyiza nnawookeera mu kiseera ekyasooka.
Yoruba: Nígbà àjàkálẹ̀-àrun Covid-19, àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ káàkiri àgbáyé gba àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ láàyè láti ṣiṣẹ́ níbikíbi (láti ilé) láti lè ri dájú pé kò sí ìfarakanra, léyìí tó jé ète pàtàkì fún ìṣedínkù àjàkálẹ̀àrùn náà ní ìṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀bẹ̀rẹ̀.
Zulu: Ngesikhathi sobhadane lwe-Covid-19, izinkampani emhlabeni jikelele zavumela abasebenzi ukuthi basebenze bekude (besekhaya) ukuze baqinisekise ukuqhelelana komphakathi, obekuyisu elibalulekile lokulawula ubhubhane.
Hausa: A yayin ɓarkewar annobar Covid-19, kamfanoni a duk duniya sun ba wa ma’aikata damar yin aiki daga nesa (daga gida) domin tabbatar da nisanta da jama'a, wanda hakan muhimmiyar dabara ce ta shawo kan annobar a farko-farko bayyanarta.
Northern Sotho: Ka nakong ya leuba la Covid-19, dikhamphani go ralala le lefase di dumeletše bašomi go šoma ba le kgole (ba le ka gae) go netefatša gore go ba le sekgoba magareng ga bašomi, e lego seo e bilego leano le bohlokwa la go laola leuba ge le sa thoma.
Amharic: በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ወቅት በዓለም ዙሪያ ያሉ ኩባንያዎች ማህበራዊ ርቀትን ለማረጋገጥ ሰራተኞቻቸውን ከሩቅ (ከቤት) እንዲሰሩ ፈቅደዋል፣ ይህም ወረርሽኙን በመጀመሪያዎቹ ደረጃዎች ለመቆጣጠር ጠቃሚ ስልት ነበር። በመጀመሪያዎቹ ደረጃዎች።

English: Now however, some businesses want their employees to come back to the office, but many employees prefer working remotely.
Luganda: Wabula mu kiseera kino, bizinensi ezimu zaagala abakozi baazo baddeyo ku wofiisi, naye ate abakozi abamu basinga kwagala kukolera waka.
Yoruba: Nísisìnyí, àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ mìíràn fẹ́ kí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ wọn padà sí ọ́fíìsì, ṣùgbọ́n ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ni wọ́n fẹ́ láti máa ṣiṣẹ́ láti ibikíbi.
Zulu: Manje nokho, amanye amabhizinisi afuna abasebenzi bawo ukuthi babuyele ehhovisi, kodwa abasebenzi abaningi bakhetha ukusebenza bekude.
Hausa: Yanzu duk da haka, wasu kasuwancin suna son ma’aikatansu su dawo ofis, amma yawancin ma’aikata sun fi son yin aiki daga nesa.
Northern Sotho: Mo lebakeng le, le ge go le bjale dikgwebo di nyaka gore bašomi ba tšona ba bowe ka dikantorong, eupša bašomi ba bantši ba rata go šoma ba le kgole.
Amharic: አሁን ግን አንዳንድ ንግዶች ሰራተኞቻቸው ወደ ቢሮ እንዲመለሱ ይፈልጋሉ፣ ነገር ግን ብዙ ሰራተኞች በርቀት መስራት ይመርጣሉ።

English: In this study, the researchers therefore wanted to understand whether employees were still productive when working remotely, and what challenges they faced during remote work.
Luganda: Noolwekyo, mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okutegeera oba ng’abakozi baali bakyakola bulungi nga bakolera ewaka, n’okumanya okusoomooza kwe baasanga nga bakolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùṣèwádìí fẹ́ ní òye nípa bóyá àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ṣì ń ní àbájáde iṣẹ́ tó dára bọ́ bá ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti ibikíbi, àti àwọn ìdojúkọ tí wọ́n ń kojú nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń ṣiṣẹ́ níbikíbi.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi-ke bafuna ukuqonda ukuthi ngabe abasebenzi basakhiqiza yini uma besebenza bekude, nokuthi yiziphi izinselelo ababhekana nazo ngesikhathi besebenza kude.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken don haka sun so su fahimci ko har yanzu ma’aikata suna da fa'ida yayin aiki daga nesa, da kuma irin ƙalubalolin da suke fuskanta yayin aiki daga nesa.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši le ge go le bjale ba be ba nhyaka go kwešiša ge eba bašomi ba sa na le tšweletšo ge ba šoma ba le kgole le mešomo, le gore ke ditlhohlo dife tše ba kopanego le tšona ka nakong ya ge ba šoma ba le kgole.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ ተመራማሪዎቹ ሰራተኞቹ ከርቀት ሲሰሩ አሁንም ምርታማ መሆናቸውን እና በሩቅ ስራ ወቅት ምን ተግዳሮቶች እንዳጋጠሟቸው ለማወቅ ፈልገዋል።

English: Understanding these factors could help businesses make better decisions about whether employees should be allowed to work remotely.
Luganda: Okutegeera ensonga zino kiyinza okuyamba bizinensi okukola okusalawo okusingako obulungi oba ng’abakozi bakkirizibwe okukolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Mímọ àwọn ìdí wọ̀nyí lè ṣe ìrànwọ́ fún àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ láti ṣe ìpinnu tó dára nípa bóyá kí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ní ààyè láti lè ṣiṣẹ́ láti ibikíbi.
Zulu: Ukuqonda lezi zici kungasiza amabhizinisi enze izinqumo ezingcono mayelana nokuthi abasebenzi kufanele bavunyelwe yini ukusebenza bekude.
Hausa: Fahimtar waɗannan abubuwan yana iya taimaka wa ’yan kasuwa su yanke shawara mafi kyau game da ko ya kamata a bar ma’aikata su yi aiki daga nesa.
Northern Sotho: Go kwešiša mabaka a go ka thuša dikgwebo go tšea diphetho tše kaone mabapi le ge eba bašomi ba swanetše go šoma ba le kgole.
Amharic: እነዚህን ምክንያቶች መረዳቱ ንግዶች ሰራተኞች በርቀት እንዲሰሩ ይፈቀድላቸው እንደሆነ የተሻለ ውሳኔ እንዲያደርጉ ሊረዳቸው ይችላል።

English: The researchers conducted a type of study called a review, where they read articles and research done by other researchers.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakola okunoonyereza okuyitibwa okwekaliriza ebiwandiiko, mwe baasomera emboozi n’okunoonyereza okwakolebwa abanoonyereza abalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà ṣe irúfẹ́ ìwádìí kan ní a pè bí àgbéyẹ̀wò, níbi tí wọ́n ti ka àkọsílẹ̀ àti iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ní àwọn olùṣèwádìí mìíràn ṣe.
Zulu: Abacwaningi benze uhlobo locwaningo olubizwa ngokuthi isibuyekezo, lapho babefunda khona izindatshana nocwaningo olwenziwa abanye abacwaningi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gudanar da wani nau’i na bincike da ake kira bita, inda suke karanta maƙaloli da kuma binciken da wasu masu bincike suka gudanar.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dirile mohuta wa dinyakišišo tše di bitšwago tekodišišo, fao ba ilego ba bala diathekele gomme mošomo wa dirwa ke banyakišiši ba bangwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በሌሎች ተመራማሪዎች የተደረጉ ጽሑፎችን እና ጥናቶችን የሚያነቡበት ግምገማ የሚባል ዓይነት ጥናት አካሂደዋል።

English: They looked for research on how employees felt about remote work, what the challenges were, and how productive employees were.
Luganda: Baafeffetta okunoonyereza okwogera ku ngeri abakozi gye bawuliramu ku kukolera ewaka, okusoomooza kwe baasanganga, n’obukozi abakozi bwe baatuukangako mu mbeera eyo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wo àwọn ìwádìí lọ́rí èro àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ nípa iṣẹ́ àṣe-níbikíbi, àwọn ohun tó jẹ́ ìdojúkọ, àti bí àbájáde iṣẹ́ wọ́n ṣe ńṣe.
Zulu: Babheke ucwaningo lokuthi izisebenzi zazizizwa kanjani ngomsebenzi osemajukujukwini, ukuthi zaziyini izinselelo, nokuthi izisebenzi zazisebenza kanjani.
Hausa: Sun nemi bincike kan yadda ma’aikata suke ji game da aiki daga nesa, mene ne ƙalubalolin, da kuma yadda ma'aikata suke da fa’ida.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba nyaka dinyakišišo tša mabapi le ka fao bašomi ba ilego ba ikwa ka gona ge ba šoma ba le kgole, gore ditlhohlo di bile dife, le gore bašomi ba bile le tšweletšo bjang.
Amharic: ሰራተኞቻቸው ስለ ሩቅ ስራ ምን እንደሚሰማቸው፣ ተግዳሮቶቹ ምን እንደሆኑ እና ሰራተኞች ምን ያህል ምርታማ እንደሆኑ ላይ ጥናት ፈልገው ነበር።

English: They discovered that most employees had a very positive attitude about working from home.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti abakozi abasinga baalina endowooza ennungi ku kukolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí pé ọ̀pọ àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ní ìmọ̀sílára tó dára nípa ṣíṣiṣẹ́ láti ilé.
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi iningi lezisebenzi lalinombono omuhle ngokusebenza ekhaya.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa yawancin ma’aikata suna da kyakkyawan hali game da aiki daga gida.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba utolla gore bontši bja bašomi ba bile le maikutlo a makaone mabapi le go šoma ba le gae.
Amharic: አብዛኞቹ ሰራተኞች ከቤት ሆነው ለመስራት ጥሩ አመለካከት እንዳላቸው ደርሰውበታል።

English: This was because working remotely meant people spent less time commuting (travelling to and from work), and could spend more time with their families.
Luganda: Kino kyali bwe kityo kubanga okukolera ewaka kitegeeza nti abantu bamala ekiseera kitono nga batambula (okugenda ku mulimu n’okudda ewaka), era nti bamala obudde obuwerako ewaka.
Yoruba: Ìdí ni pé ṣíṣiṣẹ́ láti ilé túmọ̀ sí pé àwọn ènìyàn yóò máa lo àkókò péréte láti lọ láti ibìkan sí òmíràn (lílọ sí àti padà síṣẹ́), wọ́n sì lè lo ọ̀pọ̀ àkókò pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹbí wọn.
Zulu: Lokhu kwakungenxa yokuthi ukusebenza ukude kwakusho ukuthi abantu bachitha isikhathi esincane besendleleni (beya noma bebuya emsebenzini), futhi babengachitha isikhathi esiningi nemindeni yabo.
Hausa: Wannan ya faru ne saboda yin aiki daga nesa yana nufin mutane suna kashe ɗan lokaci domin tafiya (tafiya zuwa da dawowa aiki), kuma suna iya samun ƙarin lokaci tare da iyalansu.
Northern Sotho: Se e bile ka lebaka la gore go šoma ba le kgole go ra gore batho ba tšea nako ye nnyane ba nametše dinamelwa (ba eya mošomong le go bowa), le gore ba ka tšea nako ye ntši ba na le ba malapa a bona.
Amharic: ይህ የሆነበት ምክንያት ከርቀት መስራት ሰዎች በመጓጓዣ (ወደ ሥራ እና ወደ ሥራ በመጓዝ) የሚያጠፉት ጊዜ ይቀንሳል እና ከቤተሰቦቻቸው ጋር ብዙ ጊዜ ሊያሳልፉ ስለሚችሉ ነው።

English: However, employees faced many challenges when working from home.
Luganda: Wabula, abakozi baasiŋŋaana okusoomooza kungi nga bakolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Wayí o, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ń dojúkọ oríṣiríṣi ìdíwọ́ nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń ṣiṣẹ́ láti ilé.
Zulu: Nokho, abasebenzi babhekana nezinselele eziningi lapho besebenza ekhaya.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, ma’aikata sun fuskanci kalubaloli da yawa lokacin aiki daga gida.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, bašomi ba ile ba lebana le ditlhohlo tše ntši ge ba šoma ba le gae.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ ሠራተኞቹ ከቤት ሲሠሩ ብዙ ችግሮች አጋጥሟቸዋል።

English: These included things like poor internet access, or being distracted by noise or other people.
Luganda: Muno mwalimu ebintu nga yintaneeti embi, oba okutaataganyizibwa n’okuleekaana oba abantu abalala.
Yoruba: Èyí ni àwọn ohun bíi àìdára ayélujára, tàbí ìdíwọ́ pẹ̀lú ariwo tàbí àwọn ẹlòmìíràn.
Zulu: Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinto ezifana nokungafinyeleli kahle kwe-inthanethi, noma ukuphazanyiswa umsindo noma abanye abantu.
Hausa: Waɗannan sun haɗa da abubuwa kamar rashin amfani da intanet, ko hayaniya ta kusa ko ta wasu mutane take ɗauke hankali.
Northern Sotho: Tšona di akareditše phihlelelo ye e fokolago ya inthanete, goba go šitišw ake mašata goba ke batho ba bangwe.
Amharic: እነዚህ እንደ ደካማ የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት፣ ወይም በጩኸት ወይም በሌሎች ሰዎች ምክንያት ትኩረትን ማጣት ያካትታሉ።

English: Despite these challenges, however, some of the studies they reviewed said that workers were still more productive (they were able to get more work done) when working remotely.
Luganda: Wabula, wadde nga waliwo okusoomooza okwo, ebimu ku biwandiiko bye beekaliriza byalaga nti abakozi baali bakyakola bulungi (baali basobola okukolera emirimu mingiko) nga bakolera waka.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú gbogbo ìdojúkọ wọ̀nyí, wàyí o, díẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìwádìí tí a ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò fún sọ pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ń ní àbájáde iṣẹ́ tó dára (wọ́n ń ríṣẹ́ púpọ̀ ṣe) nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń ṣiṣ́ẹ láti ibikíbi.
Zulu: Naphezu kwalezi zinselelo, nokho, ezinye zezifundo abazibukezile zathi abasebenzi basakhiqiza kakhulu (bakwazile ukwenza umsebenzi omningi) uma besebenza bekude.
Hausa: Duk da waɗannan ƙalubalolin, duk da haka, wasu binciken da suka yi nazari sun ce har yanzu ma’aikata sun fi yin ƙwazo (sun sami ƙarin aiki) yayin da suke aiki daga nesa.
Northern Sotho: Ka ntle le ditlhohlo tše, le ge go le bjale, tše dingwe tša dinyakišišo tše ba di lekodišišitšego di boletše gore bašomi ba be ba sa na le tšweletšo kudu (ba be ba kgona go phetha mošomo o montši) ge ba šoma ba le kgole.

English: They also found that when companies offer remote work as an option, they are more likely to get good workers, as compared to companies that only allow people to work from the office.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, baakizuula nti amakampuni bwe gakkiriza abakozi okukolera ewaka, balabika okufuna abakozi abalungi, bw’ogeraageranya n’amakampuni agakkiriza abantu okukolera mu woofiisi mwokka.

Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi uma izinkampani zinikeza umsebenzi okude njengenketho, maningi amathuba okuthi zithole abasebenzi abahle, uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkampani ezivumela abantu ukuthi basebenze ehhovisi kuphela.
Hausa: Sun kuma gano cewa lokacin da kamfanoni suke bayar da aiki daga nesa a matsayin zaɓi, za su iya samun ma'aikata nagari, idan aka kwatanta da kamfanonin da suke ba wa mutane damar yin aiki daga ofis kawai.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gape gore ge dikhamphani di dumelela gore bašomi ba šome ba le kgole bjalo ka kgetho, go na le kgonagalo ye kgolo ya gore di ka hwetša bašomi ba bakaone, ge go bapetšw ale dikhamphani tšeo di dumelelago fela gore ba šome ka dikantorong.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ኩባንያዎች የርቀት ሥራን እንደ አማራጭ ሲያቀርቡ፣ ከቢሮ ውስጥ ብቻ እንዲሠሩ ከሚፈቅዱ ኩባንያዎች ጋር ሲነፃፀር፣ ጥሩ ሠራተኞችን የማግኘት እድላቸው ሰፊ ነው።

English: Altogether, the researchers suggested that businesses need to adapt to remote work, and should have policies and strategies in place to ensure workers can deal with the challenges while still enjoying the benefits of working from home.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, abanoonyereza baateesa nti bizinensi zisaana okwaniriza okukolera ewaka, era balina okubeera n’enkola n’obukodyo okukakasa nti abakozi basobola okuvvuunuka okusoomooza ate ng’eno bwe baganyulwa mu birungi by’okukolera ewaka.
Yoruba: Lápapọ̀, àwọn olùṣèwádìí dábàá pé àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ gbọ́dọ̀ máa ṣàyídà sí ìṣiṣẹ́ níbikíbi, àti pé kí wọ́n ní ọ̀fin àti ètò nílè láti ri pé àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ lè yanjú àwọn ìdojúkọ nígbà tí wọ́n bá ṣì ń gbádùn ère ṣíṣiṣẹ́ láti ilé.
Zulu: Sekukonke, abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi amabhizinisi adinga ukuzivumelanisa nomsebenzi okude, futhi kufanele abe nezinqubomgomo namasu okuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bangakwazi ukubhekana nezinselele ngenkathi bejabulela izinzuzo zokusebenza ekhaya.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa kasuwancin suna buƙatar daidaitawa da aiki mai nisa, kuma yakamata su kasance da tsare-tsare da dabaru don tabbatar da cewa ma’aikata za su iya tinkarar ƙalubalen yayin da suke ci gaba da cin gajiyar aiki daga gida.
Northern Sotho: Ka moka, banyakišiši ba ile ba šišinya gore dikgwebo di swanetše go tlwaela gore bašomi ba šome ba le gae le gore di swanetše go ba le melawana le maano a go netefatša gore bašomi ba kgona go šoma ka ditlhohlo mola ka go le lengwe ba ipshina ka menyetla ya go šoma ba le ka gae.
